title: A brief history of the Bloomberg terminal
why_read: A historical look at the Bloomberg Terminal is a solid read for engineers interested in the technical and business evolution of a legendary enterprise system.
analysis: The Bloomberg Terminal is one of the longest-running and most profitable enterprise software products in history, combining a proprietary keyboard, closed network, and dense data interface. A history piece on it would likely cover its origins in the 1980s, its unusual pricing model, and why it remains hard to displace despite modern web-based competitors. This is interesting from a systems and business-model perspective even though it is not cutting-edge technology. The topic has enduring appeal for engineers curious about why some legacy enterprise systems persist for decades.
